name: ADA - Autonomous Dev Agents
description: Deploy an autonomous AI development team to your GitHub repo. ADA runs 24/7, triaging issues, writing code, creating PRs, and managing your project.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope. Get one at: github.com/settings/tokens

GITHUB_REPO.description: Target repository in owner/repo format (e.g., myorg/myproject)

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude LLM. Get one at: console.anthropic.com

ADA_DISPATCH_INTERVAL.description: How often to run dispatch cycles (e.g., 15m, 30m, 1h)

ADA_MODEL_ROUTING.description: Enable automatic cost-optimized model selection per role

ADA_MODEL_OVERRIDE.description: Force a specific model for all roles (haiku, sonnet, opus). Leave empty for auto.

ADA_MODEL_FALLBACK.description: Enable fallback to stronger models if validation fails
